partido: Lisandro Martinez critica a la directiva tras Atletico 2-0 Man United
text:
Lisandro Martínez after Man United's 2-0 loss at Atlético: “If you don’t change, next season is a big problem.” Same night: 1-0 down after 53 seconds, then Yoro sent off. Is he right? 👇
